about.title: About Debt Consolidation Calculator - Debt Management Tool
about.description: The Debt Consolidation Calculator is a comprehensive debt management tool designed to help you evaluate the benefits of consolidating multiple debts into a single loan. This calculator helps you compare your current debt payments with potential consolidation options, calculate interest savings, and determine if debt consolidation makes financial sense. Whether you're dealing with credit card debt, personal loans, or other high-interest obligations, this tool provides clear analysis of consolidation scenarios.

faq.q: When does debt consolidation make sense?
faq.a: Debt consolidation makes sense when you can secure a lower interest rate than your current average, simplify payments, or reduce monthly obligations. It's most beneficial for high-interest credit card debt when you can get a personal loan or balance transfer at a lower rate.

faq.q: What types of debt can be consolidated?
faq.a: Most unsecured debts can be consolidated including credit cards, personal loans, medical bills, and store credit accounts. Secured debts like mortgages and auto loans typically cannot be included in standard debt consolidation.

faq.q: Will debt consolidation hurt my credit score?
faq.a: Initially, debt consolidation may cause a small, temporary dip in your credit score due to the hard inquiry. However, it can improve your score long-term by reducing credit utilization and making payments more manageable.

faq.q: What are the risks of debt consolidation?
faq.a: Risks include potentially paying more interest over time if you extend the repayment period, accumulating new debt on cleared credit cards, and possible fees. Some people also lose motivation to pay off debt quickly with lower monthly payments.
